end.parentNote: Kavya practised comparing festival customs and connecting harvest festivals with crops. They gave examples such as Onam with pookalam and Bihu with pitha, and shared that Diwali at home includes gajar ka halwa and flower rangoli. Kavya still mixed up harvest timing with choosing any festival date, and this was not corrected by the end. At home, ask them to match one harvest festival with the crop season and discuss why the timing matters.
